Name: Juna for NPC Adventures
Author: elhrvy
Description:
Invite a scheming ballerina to go adventuring with you! Fight in the mines, forage in the woods, scheme in the town, hate on the beach.

Juna in the mines is as Juna in life: an unpredictable, chatty mess. Sometimes she slays, sometimes she heals, sometimes she makes monsters peaceful. And sometimes she slays and makes them peaceful at the same time? Seems unfair, but like I said: she's a mess.

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8606]Juna[/url] (+ dependencies) and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4582]NPC Adventures[/url] (+ dependencies).

As of February 2023, there are three options to choose from:

⭐ STABLE version:
Requires the stable version of NPC Adventures.
Juna is recruitable once you've reached 5 hearts with her (and have seen the NPC Adventures event at the Guild).
[b]Classes[/b]: Warrior, Doctor, Spiritual.
[b]Buffs[/b]: Being around Juna somehow makes it easier to let the bad stuff simply roll off your back. You gain +3 to Defense, +2 to Luck, +1 to Foraging and +30 Energy.

⭐ BETA version, option 1:
Requires the beta version of NPC Adventures.
Juna is recruitable once you've reached 6 hearts with her (and have seen the NPC Adventures event at the Guild).
[b]Classes: [/b]Warrior, Doctor, Spiritual.
[b]Buffs[/b]: Being around Juna somehow makes it easier to let the bad stuff simply roll off your back. You gain +3 to Defense, +2 to Luck, +1 to Foraging and +30 Energy.

⭐ BETA version, option 2:
Requires the beta version of NPC Adventures.
Juna is recruitable once you've reached 6 hearts with her (and have seen the NPC Adventures event at the Guild).
[b]Classes: [/b]Warrior, Protector (sometimes Juna distract monsters with her chaotic nature, making you temporarily invulnerable.)
[b]Buffs[/b]: Being around Juna somehow makes it easier to let the bad stuff simply roll off your back. You gain +3 to Defense, +2 to Luck, +1 to Foraging and +30 Energy.

[center][i]Please see sticky post for information on the "losing hearts bug/feature". [/i]﻿[/center]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/8ebHgHR.png[/img]

Thanks for playing![/center]
